entries.title: Pinning down the structure of quark-gluon plasma, the universe's first fluid
entries.summary: In the first fraction of a second following the Big Bang, matter existed as a trillion-degree plasma of quarks and gluons—subatomic particles that zinged around at close to the speed of light. This roiling soup lasted for just a few microseconds before the particles coalesced…

entries.title: Electrical control of an unconventional quantum transport state demonstrated in a magnet for the first time
entries.summary: Researchers at Tohoku University and the Japan Atomic Energy Agency (JAEA) have successfully controlled a unique quantum phenomenon—the quantum-geometric nonlinear Hall (QgNLH) state—using electric current for the first time. The breakthrough was achieved by revealing and…

entries.title: How palm orientation shapes spin characteristics in volleyball jump serves
entries.summary: A new biomechanical study has uncovered how elite volleyball players control ball spin during jump serves, offering fresh scientific insight into one of the sport's most decisive offensive skills.

entries.title: Physicist develops detector capable of counting photons for quantum computing
